title: Representative Payee and Guardianship Terms, Resident Trust Fund Accounts
content:
Two of the Resident Trust Fund Accounts tier families carry duties that the self-directed tiers do not: the representative payee tiers, where Keystone Ridge receives the resident's Social Security benefits as SSA representative payee, and the guardianship tiers, where a court-appointed guardian of the estate directs the funds.

| Tier | Center is SSA representative payee | Benefits applied first to current maintenance, then saved | Annual payee accounting filed with SSA | Monthly center bill paid from benefits as payee | Payee transfer to a monthly bill needs a resident request | Personal needs allowance stays in the account after patient pay is transferred | Annual accounting for the guardian's Orphans' Court report |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Self-Directed | No | No | No | none | Yes | Yes | No |
| Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Representative Payee | Yes | Yes | Yes | Medicaid patient pay | No | Yes | No |
| Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Guardianship | No | No | No | none | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Resident Funds Account, Non-Medicaid Self-Directed | No | No | No | none | Yes | No | No |
| Resident Funds Account, Non-Medicaid Representative Payee | Yes | Yes | Yes | private room and board | No | No | No |
| Resident Funds Account, Non-Medicaid Guardianship | No | No | No | none | Yes | No | Yes |

## Notes

- In the two representative payee tiers the payee applies benefits to the tier's monthly center bill without a monthly request from the resident: Medicaid patient pay in the Medicaid Representative Payee tier, private room and board in the Non-Medicaid Representative Payee tier.
- The personal needs allowance stays in the account in the Medicaid Representative Payee tier; the column reads "Yes" for the other two Medicaid tiers as well, and "No" for the Non-Medicaid tiers.
- The guardianship tiers are the only tiers in which an annual accounting is prepared for the guardian's report to the Orphans' Court.
